mechanism: Isocarboxazid (MAOI) may potentiate sympathomimetic effects and increase risk of hypertensive crisis; dapagliflozin increases urinary glucose excretion and infection risk, which combined with MAOI use requires careful monitoring.
action: Monitor blood pressure closely; educate patient on dietary tyramine restrictions; assess need for alternative antidiabetic or antidepressant agent if interaction outweighs benefits.
